items.title: Data & AI Weekly | Ep.1 | What Nobody Tells You About Becoming a Senior Data Engineer
items.author: Redpanda Data
items.summary: What does it actually take to become a senior data engineer, and stay relevant as AI changes the job? In this episode, Redpanda CTO Tyler Akidau talks with engineers who've made the jump, the leaders who promoted them, and a technical recruiter who hires for these roles. They cover the skills, decisions, and career moments that don't show up in any job description.

items.title: Data & AI Weekly | Ep. 2 | How the Best Data Teams Build for Real-Time
items.author: Redpanda Data
items.summary: Real-time data is no longer a nice-to-have. But building for it well is a bigger challenge than most teams anticipate. In this episode, Redpanda CMO Melissa Czapiga sits down with Tyler Hannan, Senior Director of Developer Advocacy at ClickHouse, to unpack the architectural decisions, operational tradeoffs, and hard-won lessons behind the data teams getting real-time right.
